cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lead the workshop move. Are you backing my plan or Morgan's when we meet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can build that into my proposal. You choose how we explain the figures. Whose plan will you say you're supporting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call it a compromise. I don't want a fight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No fight. Use your word, and I'll keep the discussion calm. But if Morgan says you've joined his side, do I agree with him or tell the room you're with me?
